traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and named requirements for 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT are implemented and verified. The plugin now parses @supports annotations, validates their story paths and requirement IDs, integrates them into deep requirement validation with scoped IDs, treats @supports as satisfying both story and requirement annotation rules, supports mixed @story/@req/@supports usage, and exposes clear error messages and migration documentation. Comprehensive Jest tests tied directly to this story confirm the behavior, and the full test suite passes.
